text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса, cheered on by her
friends, does
an incredible job in the
Kyodo News Hai.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, this race is only a stepping
stone. Now
that she has strayed from the
Classic route, she
wonders what to do
for her next race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Сикинг зе Пёрл, an older student who
El
Condor Pasa looks up to, suggests
taking on the
NHK Mile Cup.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса decides to step into the
G1 to
prove herself to the world. It's
sure to be an
intense battle.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
